title: smartinvest.ai
tagline: AI chatbot for NFT insights, ENS identities, and social links to make smarter decisions
description:
This project is an AI-powered chatbot for the crypto and NFT space, designed to turn complex blockchain data into clear, actionable insights. By integrating directly with OpenSea MCP, it provides real-time access to token balances, NFT holdings, swap quotes, and market trends. Users can simply ask questions in natural language—like “what does this wallet hold?” or “swap my ETH to PYUSD”—and the chatbot responds with portfolio analysis, trade-ready actions, or market intelligence, all within a conversational interface.

Beyond numbers, the platform makes Web3 more human by using ENS names to resolve wallet addresses into recognizable identities and, where possible, link them to social profiles. This lets users not only analyze the ecosystem but also connect with the people behind the wallets, bridging the gap between pseudonymous blockchain activity and real-world social discovery. In short, it’s an onchain research assistant and social layer rolled into one, helping anyone navigate, understand, and act in Web3 more intelligently.
how_its_made:
We built this project on Next.js with the Vercel AI SD to power the chat interface and tool orchestration. The assistant connects directly to the OpenSea MCP, using endpoints like balances, NFT holdings, profiles, and swap quotes to pull real-time data and feed it into the conversation. This makes it possible to “ask your wallet anything” and get structured, live answers that feel natural in chat.

To humanize the experience, we layered in ENS L2 Primary Names so raw wallet addresses resolve into recognizable names and avatars. This gives users a face and identity for each account, helping them understand who they’re interacting with across chains. The combination of MCP’s detailed data and ENS-based identity resolution creates a seamless AI assistant for exploring, analyzing, and acting in the crypto and NFT space.
